evidence: books/store-log-damage.lisp:268-272: `(defun fn-lgdm-quarantine-name (v segment) ... (concatenate 'string (if (stringp segment) segment "segment") ".damaged-at-" (fn-lgdm-dec (nth 1 v)))))`; host/native/io.lisp:6676: `(out (fnn-open target (logior sb-posix:o-wronly sb-posix:o-creat sb-posix:o-excl +fnn-o-nofollow+)))`.
fix: Stage the quarantine under staging/ with a .stage- name (swept on open) and rename it into quarantine/ only after it is fenced. When the final name already exists with the same size and content digest, treat the copy as done and continue the repair. Otherwise refuse by name (quarantine-exists) instead of with an EEXIST OS error.
notes: 10-02 23:24 escalate: quarantine open is in host/native/io.lisp (forbidden zone) and the name/verdict is in books/store-log-damage.lisp (ACL2 decision)
10-02 23:25 already fixed at this base (866590229 S040/S124): fnn-log-quarantine and fn-xw-quarantine copy under quarantine/.stage-NAME, fence, rename; an existing NAME is kept as a complete copy
reviewer: fn-lgdm-quarantine-name (store-log-damage.lisp:268-272) is a pure function of the segment name and the stop offset. fnn-log-quarantine (io.lisp:6666-6687) opens the final name directly with O_CREAT|O_EXCL: there is no temporary file and no rename. A process death part-way through the copy leaves a partial file under that name. A rerun computes the same name, fails with EEXIST, and that surfaces as a raw error rather than a named refusal. Someone has to intervene by hand, and they cannot tell a partial copy from a complete one.
scenario: The operator runs `store recover --repair truncate 000003.log:P`. The process dies after quarantine/000003.log.damaged-at-P is created but before the tail is zeroed (for example mid-copy of a large segment). The rerun computes the same verdict and the same name, and the O_EXCL open fails with EEXIST. That surfaces as a raw OS error rather than a named refusal, and the repair cannot complete until someone manually deletes the partial quarantine file. If they delete a complete one instead, they lose the only kept copy of the dropped entries.
title: A death during the repair's quarantine copy makes the repair impossible to rerun: the quarantine name is deterministic and opened O_EXCL
